messages:
Kai: Quick idea for Sunday morning 10am 12pm: Dim sum + tiny puzzle race in the lounge? Coffee, tea, and mini prizes. Low-key event. Thoughts?
Lina: Yum. Dim sum before noon = yes. Where to order from?
Marco: Golden Basket usually does small steamers for takeout. I can swing by.
Sofia: In! I
 love to run a 20-min jigsaw relay and a 15-min crossword sprint. Prizes = stickers + mystery snack.
Ellen: Can we make a kid-friendly corner? My niece might come.
Kai: Good call 
 we'll set up a coloring / puzzle corner. Adults can do the timed races, kids can have puzzles.
Marco: RSVP format: "Yes/Maybe/No + headcount + want dim sum (Y/N) + dietary notes"
Lina: Yes / 1 / Y / no pork pls (vegetarian ok).
:calendar-bot: Event created  "Dim Sum Duel & Puzzle Race"  Sun 2025-06-15 10:00  Location: Lounge (alt: Commons). RSVP in thread.
Sofia: I'll bring printed crosswords and a 200-piece jigsaw. Also a sand timer.
Ellen: Maybe / 2 adults + 1 kid / Y / nut allergy in kid (no peanuts pls).
Kai: Marco can you grab extra tea kettles and napkins? @facilities any concerns about food in the lounge that morning?
facilities: Quick note: lounge reservations for weekend mornings are fine but please leave tables clear of trash. We'll provide one recycling bin and one compost bin.
Marco: Yep 
 tea, napkins, compostable chopsticks on me. I1 pick up a veggie dim sum box too.
Lina: Also can we do a tiny poll for prize preference: nerdy stickers vs. instant ramen packs?
Sofia: Stickers pls.
Ellen: Ramen packs are too spicy for the kid 
 stickers for me too.
Kai: Poll tomorrow 9am. Plan: 10:00 coffee, 10:15 dim sum drop + mingle, 10:30 puzzle relays, 11:15 free play / kid corner, 11:50 prize ceremony, finish noon.
Marco: Sounds good. I'll RSVP in the calendar once food count is firm.
Lina: :tada: excited!
